title: Wanda V STE
content:
At the time of the event, I was in conversation with a man whom I loved and trusted completely. The man later told me that he loved me as well, but at the time of the event, our feelings had not yet been expressed.

We were sitting and talking across from each other. He was telling me about his mother and how she had to flee Europe as a teenager with only a few hours' notice from her parents. I felt a great deal of empathy for his mother as he spoke. At a certain point, he looked into my eyes. I think he realized that I loved him. He became still and looked intently into my eyes.

At that moment, my vision was filled with blue light. I had the sensation of rushing into a tunnel filled with that same light. As the sensation faded, I found myself in a different dimension. I felt connected to him but couldn’t see him. I could only feel him as a warm presence that was somehow connected to me, like holding hands without contact. It was dark around us, but I could see a world laid out below me, with stars or points of light scattered in the darkness. There was also another presence there. Although, I couldn’t see it, I could only feel it. That presence seemed surprised and amused by us. I felt a deep sense of exhilaration. As I gazed at the world below, I got a sense of how everything worked, that there were plans and a sense of purpose, and I also experienced self-realization about what I was capable of. At that point, I felt a probing from him, as if he were trying to go deeper into me or into the experience somehow. I felt a stab of fear, and immediately the connection was broken, and we came back to earth.

arrival.other_being_detail: A second unseen presence that "seemed surprised and amused by us."

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness with "a world laid out below" and "stars or points of light scattered in the darkness."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Connection to the man as an unseen warm presence; another unseen presence that felt surprised/amused; fear causing abrupt return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blue light and rushing tunnel first, then arrival into a dark dimension with points of light and presences, then abrupt return triggered by fear.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience appears triggered during an intense interpersonal gaze/conversation rather than a described medical crisis; sustained felt-connection to a living person as an unseen warm presence.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "my vision was filled with blue light"; "rushing into a tunnel filled with that same light"; "a world laid out below me, with stars or points of light scattered in the darkness"; "surprised and amused by us"; "like holding hands without contact"
